maxwell.headline: House Resolution 119-635 formally opposing Maxwell clemency proposed by Rep. Krishnamoorthi on August 5, 2026, while Maxwell's lawyers continue seeking clemency deal and Congress reviews unredacted Epstein files
maxwell.summary: Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi has proposed House Resolution 119-635 to the US House Committee on the Judiciary, formally opposing any clemency for Ghislaine Maxwell and affirming her conviction was warranted by the facts. The resolution states that clemency would deny survivors justice. This represents new Congressional action beyond the Senate resolution previously passed. Meanwhile, Maxwell's lawyers continue seeking a clemency deal offering 'full and honest' testimony about her Epstein relationship, and members of Congress are reviewing unredacted Epstein files with note-taking privileges but no electronic copying allowed. BBC reporting indicates survivors continue speaking publicly about their experiences.

Pakistan confirmed it will host US-Iran talks following diplomatic meetings, though Iran maintains its position of 'no cessation of hostilities, no negotiations.' israel.headline: Israel conducting expanded ground invasion of southern Lebanon targeting Litani River while striking Iranian weapons facilities in Tehran, with 3 UN peacekeepers killed and IDF battalion suspended for assaulting CNN crew on March 29-30, 2026
israel.summary: Israel has escalated from limited incursions to a broad ground offensive in southern Lebanon, with Netanyahu ordering expansion of operations to halt Hezbollah rockets and seize territory up to the Litani River. Three UN peacekeepers were killed in the intensified fighting, marking a significant escalation. The IDF suspended the Netzah Yehuda battalion after soldiers were filmed assaulting a CNN crew in the West Bank, representing rare disciplinary action. Simultaneously, Israel continues striking Iranian weapons production facilities in Tehran and Isfahan, with over 120 munitions dropped on research and development sites. The multi-front operations demonstrate Israel's expanded military posture across both the Lebanon and Iran theaters.

Despite beating estimates, the stock remains down 24.6% over three months. Oracle reported record $553B remaining performance obligations backlog, with AI infrastructure growth of 200% and cloud revenue up 44%. Multiple analysts maintain Buy ratings, but the stock faces headwinds from broader market conditions despite strong fundamentals.

Separately, Google has agreed to support construction of a new 600-megawatt solar and 350-megawatt battery facility through Entergy Arkansas that will serve all customers. Microsoft is also expanding data center operations in Texas with 10 total buildings planned for 2.1 gigawatts of capacity. The construction activity aligns with the structural leverage framework established by Acts 373/548 and the Strategic Investment Rider mechanism.
